software_checks.note: Framework tests use fake driver and real Humble lifecycle/DDS. Final stop-handling refinements are software-regression-tested, not physically requalified.

interpretation.native: START, out/return, cancellation/recovery passed. GENERATE failed before native START and succeeded afterward without measured motion. Returned trajectory analysis can reflect prior execution and is not a generated waypoint output.
interpretation.torque: Earlier 150 ms failure retained. New 50 ms 0.02 Nm damped pulse passed a 5 mrad envelope; observed post-exit max displacement 0.003466 rad. Experimental flag retained.
interpretation.interaction: 100 ms compliant and 0.05 N force sessions confirmed active/inactive; no process-kill test or proof of automatic deactivation after process loss.
interpretation.enable: Disable cleared homed before the guarded enable attempt. Motion while not ready may involve homing, but the cause and safe recovery procedure are not established. No further reset/enable retry.
interpretation.errors: Live error/log definitions were supplied by controller publisher headers and MD5-checked using development-only genpy. No new private command schema was guessed or added to runtime.
